$comment: Phase 9 full structured extraction. Every field is transcribed verbatim from curriculum-sources/Government-Curriculum.pdf (pages 21-75 printed / raw PDF pages 23-77) via `pdftotext -layout -enc UTF-8`. Nothing here is invented. Convention note: `nationalCoreValues` is stored as a single-element array containing the full verbatim 'National Core Values:' text block for each node, rather than split into individual words, because in this document that text is usually a flowing sentence (not a clean comma bullet list) and splitting it risked misjudging word boundaries / paraphrasing. `pedagogicalExemplars` likewise preserves each verbatim paragraph/sub-list as its own array element, in original order, without merging or rewording. Several genuine source data-quality issues were found (duplicated content block, code-prefix mismatches, Scope-and-Sequence-table vs. body-text indicator-count mismatches, a merged sub-strand heading) -- these are preserved as printed and flagged with reviewStatus NEEDS_REVIEW and a reviewNote at the affected node, per extraction instructions. One character-doubling rendering artefact on a page footer/label line ('GTeoavecrhnimngenatnd' = 'Teaching and'+'Government' interleaved) was cleaned up as a footer/label glitch only, not as body content.

learningOutcomes.description: Evaluate the meanings, concepts, principles of government and importance of government.

guidance.twentyFirstCenturySkills: Critical thinking skills: Learners brainstorm the meanings of government. Through further probing of responses during brainstorming sessions. Make simple modifications to known ideas and routine solutions to generate some different ideas and possibilities. Compare and contrast information and ideas in own and others' reasoning. Consider how reasons and examples are used to support a point of view and illustrate meaning. Consider ways to express and describe thinking activity, including the expression of feelings about learning, both to others and self. Generate ideas that are new and make choices after considering personal preferences. Communication skills: Learners engage in brainstorming session. Learners develop critical analytical and verbal skills. Creativity and Innovation: introduction of new ideas during role-play sessions.
guidance.gesiSelHeaderSeen: GESI1, SEL2 and Shared National Values
guidance.gesi: Having used problem-based and experiential learning, taking into consideration Gender Equality and Social Inclusion and working with each other in an inclusive way, the learners will acquire the following GESI competencies: Begin to appreciate individuals of different beliefs, political views and leanings, cultures, and religion. Question the value of democratic and inclusive society. Being to understand diversity and inclusion. Identify misconceptions/myths about gender and disabilities as they relate to governance and leadership. Become aware of their stereotypes and biases about gender roles in governance and political leadership. Begin to appreciate capacity building to be an effective leader.
guidance.sel: SEL: learners having gone through the teaching method Helps them to build self-confidence and be assertive in decision making in the society. Tolerate other viewpoints to promote harmony.
nationalCoreValues: Learner's full participation and understanding during class discussion will convey the values of tolerance, courage, and loyalty. Embrace diversity of ideas during the brainstorming session. Discussion and understanding of the basic concepts and principles of government will instil in learners the values of tolerance, confidence, and courage. Teamwork by respecting diverse views and gender inclusion while working in group sessions. The use of role-play the functions of government will convey the values of hard work, honesty, patriotism, and loyalty.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of the meanings, basic concepts, principles, and importance of government.
